cohort: The study included 12,351 nulliparous, term, singleton, vertex presentation (NTSV) individuals who underwent cesarean deliveries at the institution from 2016 to 2020.
finding: Non-Hispanic White people showed increased odds of cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR) compared to Asian/Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, Black, and Hispanic people.
mod_finding: Non-Hispanic White people underwent cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR) more frequently than other racial and ethnic groups among low-risk nulliparous patients.
